children: Sensient Technologies amended and restated its trade receivables securitization program to increase the facility limit to $115 million, add PNC as a purchaser and administrative agent, and extend the program to August 30, 2027. Wells Fargo remains a purchaser, and PNC Capital Markets serves as structuring agent. The move is intended to enhance liquidity and working capital flexibility by broadening counterparties and extending tenor.
: Amended and restated trade receivables securitization program
: PNC Bank; Wells Fargo Bank; PNC Capital Markets
: Increase liquidity and extend receivables financing capacity
